_note: v2.4 plan 02 step 2, row 'no-op edit' (plan 02 section 2 'Mutation events'; host fact recorded here, 2026-09-24). No backend. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-02-noop-edit.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088. Host fact, verified in ST source: closing the message editor with Done calls messageEditDone (script.js:8397-8435), which emits MESSAGE_EDITED (:8405) and MESSAGE_UPDATED (:8431) for the edited id UNCONDITIONALLY, whether or not the text changed; opening it is the delegated .mes_edit click (script.js:11829-11858, messageEdit :8240). Three player lines are consumed (each with a latching delta and a fact quoting it); then the real editor is opened on the consumed lamp line (message 1) and closed with Done without touching the text. Asserts: no rollback since the mark, and the whole story (values, versions, active, path, boundary, memory, epistemic, ledger) equal to the recording. A control then makes a REAL edit of message 2 through the edit verb and expects an applied rollback from 2, which proves the harness sees rollbacks at all. EXPECTED RED on today's code at the first assertion: TurnBridge.onMutation rolls back on every edit/update id with unchanged text included (turnBridge.ts:171-189), and lit_lamp/found_map were applied at boundaries whose windows reach message 1 (engine.shouldRollbackFromMessage), so rollbackOutcome reports 'applied from 1' and the lamp and map state is dropped. Green once T3's unchanged-hash short-circuit lands (mutation check 6).

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so every message id below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (!state || state.activeCheckpointId !== 'start') throw new Error(`the story did not load at start: ${JSON.stringify(state && state.activeCheckpointId)}`); return { cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0, boundary: state.boundary };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const lines = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.map((m) => m.mes); const state = rt.getEngineState(); const values = state.blackboard.values; if (lines.length !== 3 || !String(lines[1]).includes('oil lamp')) throw new Error(`the chat is not the three scripted lines: ${JSON.stringify(lines)}`); if (state.lastMessageId !== 2) throw new Error(`the engine consumed up to message ${state.lastMessageId}, expected 2`); for (const key of ['took_key', 'lit_lamp', 'found_map']) if (values[key] !== true) throw new Error(`${key} did not land before the edit: ${JSON.stringify(values)}`); return { values, boundary: state.boundary };

const $ = globalThis.jQuery; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const until = async (test, what) => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i += 1) { if (test()) return; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error(`the message editor never ${what}`); }; const before = ctx.chat[1].mes; const seen = []; const onEdited = (id) => seen.push(['MESSAGE_EDITED', id]); const onUpdated = (id) => seen.push(['MESSAGE_UPDATED', id]); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_EDITED, onEdited); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_UPDATED, onUpdated); try { $('.mes[mesid="1"] .mes_edit').first().trigger('click'); await until(() => document.querySelector('#curEditTextarea'), 'opened on message 1'); const box = document.querySelector('#curEditTextarea'); if (box.value !== before) throw new Error(`the editor opened on other text: ${JSON.stringify(box.value)}`); $('.mes[mesid="1"] .mes_edit_done').first().trigger('click'); await until(() => !document.querySelector('#curEditTextarea'), 'closed'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); } finally { ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_EDITED, onEdited); ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_UPDATED, onUpdated); } if (ctx.chat[1].mes !== before) throw new Error(`the no-op edit changed the text: ${JSON.stringify(ctx.chat[1].mes)}`); if (!seen.some(([name]) => name === 'MESSAGE_EDITED')) throw new Error(`the host emitted no MESSAGE_EDITED for an unchanged edit, so this fixture tests nothing: ${JSON.stringify(seen)}`); return { unchanged: true, events: seen };
